thread.title: Surveys

title: Surveys
text:
NFIB values your feedback and would like to hear key issues such as taxes, healthcare, and/or regulations impact your business. Our brief surveys will only take a moment of your time but provide valuable insights for us. You can contribute to one survey, or complete them all. Thank you for sharing with us.
Surveys
Surveys
Make Your Voice Heard in Congress
Tax Policy
The historic Tax Cuts and Jobs Act benefited most small businesses, but many still find their tax burden a critical problem. Share how taxes impact your business.
Tax Policy Survey
Finding Employees
Small businesses are America’s job creators, but finding qualified employees is increasingly difficult. In NFIB’s Small Business Economic Trends survey, “quality of labor” is often cited as the top challenge.
Please share your experiences as an employer by completing our labor survey.
Finding Employees Survey
Healthcare Reform
NFIB continues to tirelessly urge lawmakers to pursue policy solutions that will empower small business owners with more choice and control over their healthcare decisions, and lower healthcare costs while expanding affordable coverage options.
Healthcare Survey
Federal Regulations
Our efforts are strong because they are supported by the real voices of small business owners. Please help us continue to inform lawmakers about your perspective on regulations by taking this short survey.
Federal Regulations Survey
